mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting circulation to the filtration route was most worthwhile because it showed that useful glucose enters the filtrate alongside water, salts and urea, and distinguished filtrate from finished urine.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first connection was least worthwhile on its own: it produced a named route without explaining what passed through it, and it was the only offered action.

surprise.text: Seeing glucose leave the blood during filtration clarified why recovery is necessary; a filter does not simply remove waste while retaining everything useful.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each connection related to the stated goal. However, the menu supplied the only compatible action each time, so I did not have to work out compatibility.

continue.text: I would probably continue briefly to see how this connects to the body's response to a drink. The explanation was useful, but I would hope for more meaningful choices and detail than this short sequence provided.
